description: External reference sources consulted when authoring the Airify PM2.5 Daily Intake Criteria v0.1 wording. Airify does NOT reproduce or endorse these as medical advice; they are cited to keep the operational reference tiers transparent and revisable. No source here has been re-validated by Airify, and no Airify model accuracy is implied.

sources.name: WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines 2021 — PM2.5
sources.used_for: General direction for concentration reference bands (annual/24h). Reference only.
sources.note: Reference for operational tiers, not a medical safety limit inside Airify.

sources.name: Thailand Pollution Control Department / Air4Thai PM2.5 reporting
sources.used_for: Local PM2.5 reporting context (Thailand). Provider role: PM2.5 source (future live integration, not connected in demo).
sources.note: Not integrated in the current demo; listed for provenance.

sources.name: US EPA Exposure Factors Handbook — inhalation rate references
sources.used_for: Inhalation-rate direction for the ADD / estimated-inhaled-PM2.5 formula (environmental estimate only).
sources.note: Used for the exposure-layer estimate, not for any health-outcome claim.

validation_status: Not independently validated by Airify. No MAE/RMSE or clinical validation exists.
boundary: Environmental exposure estimate only. Not medical diagnosis. Not clinical decision support.
